management_steps.details: Chronic paronychia: apply at night until lesions clear. Atopic eczema (Step 3): apply ointment once daily for 7 days. Seborrhoeic dermatitis: apply ointment once daily for 5-7 days. Psoriasis: apply 12 hourly.
Doctor prescribed. Do not apply to face, neck and flexures for eczema and seborrhoeic dermatitis.
